target_customer: US businesses with hard to place commercial risks in construction, trucking, logistics, manufacturing and hospitality, plus overloaded brokers who hand over servicing and renewals
problem: Standard insurers reject complex risks and brokers spend most of their time on coordination, submissions and service work.
business_model: Commission based surplus lines insurance brokerage using AI agents with licensed human brokers

founders.name: Vincent Chen
founders.background_notes: Three years at Google on deep learning and agentic AI including NotebookLM and Google Photos. Licensed commercial insurance broker per the launch post.

founders.name: Frank Wang
founders.background_notes: YC page and launch post describe his Apple role differently.

competitors.name: Harper
competitors.what: AI native commercial insurance brokerage, also a YC company
competitors.funding_then: about 47 million dollars Series A and seed announced February 2026

technical_complexity.rationale: AI agents operating inside broker systems for submissions, follow ups and certificates with human approval and logs. Mostly applied LLM engineering plus insurance licensing and carrier integration.

defensibility.rationale: Broker licensing is a barrier but not a strong one, and several AI native brokerages launched at the same time. Carrier relationships may build over time.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Well funded AI brokerages such as Harper raised large rounds in early 2026, and incumbents were investing in AI workflows. No acquisition of Panta found.

market_need_then: The company cites the E&S market at 125 billion dollars of annual premium and says it produced bindable quotes in three days for an armed security firm that six other brokers declined. Both are company claims.

branding.domain_note: Uses pantainsure.com, a suffixed domain rather than panta.com, per the company site.

identity.voice_and_tone: Direct, operations focused, argues for removing the human coordination layer

brand_strength.rationale: Only listing pages and a launch post exist. No press about the brand and no source for the name's meaning.

outcome_analysis: Panta is a three person W26 company that says it has been in production since December 2025 placing coverage for hard to place risks. Public information is limited to the YC page, a launch post and directory listings, and no verified round or customer is named. The main risk is competition from better funded AI native brokerages such as Harper in the same batch period.
notes: Unverified funding: Dealroom shows a January 2026 seed of $125K at a $500K valuation with Y Combinator; CB Insights shows $500K over 3 rounds with 1984 Ventures; Standout shows $6M total. They conflict, so no round is recorded. Founding year conflicts (2025 on YC, 2024 on Dealroom). Delegance and Outmarket AI are other AI commercial insurance entrants found but not dated in the snippets, so omitted. Recorded as of the W26 batch which began early 2026. Completeness pass: Round added from Dealroom (125K seed January 2026 at 500K valuation, a database figure); CB Insights shows 500K and Standout 6M total, which conflict and are not recorded. Rests on a single database.
